questions.question: When a number is added to thrice its preceding number, and the sum of these two numbers is divided by 5, 13 is obtained as the result. Find that number.
questions.solution:
Given,

The number is added to thrice its preceding number.

Let us consider number = X

The other number is = 3(X - 1)

The sum of these two numbers is divided by 5, 13

⇒ (X + 3(X - 1) ) ÷ 5 × 13 = 1

⇒ X + 3X - 3 = 65

⇒ 4X - 3 = 65

⇒ 4X = 68

⇒** X = 17**

Hence, the correct answer is **"17".**

questions.question: A class has a total of 30 students. Aaditya is at 11th rank in merit order from the top. What is the rank of Aaditya from the bottom?
questions.solution:
Given,

Total number of students in class = 30

 Aaditya is at 11th rank in merit order from the top.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/739380da42eefafd7caa88da5805a90355979cf55a3e42da25fe9f982de11d2b.png] 

The Rank of Aaditya from bottom = Number of students in class - Aaditya rank from top + 1

The Rank of Aaditya from bottom = 30 - 11 + 1

The Rank of Aaditya from bottom = 31 - 11

The Rank of Aaditya from bottom = 20

∴ Here, the Rank of Aaditya from bottom is 20th.

Hence, the correct answer is **"20th".**

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

Q _ T J _ Q R _ J C _ R T _ C Q _ T _ C

options.text: R C J Q J R R
R C Q T J R J
R C T Q J R J
C R T Q J R J

questions.solution:
Given :- Q _ T J _ Q R _ J C _ R T _ C Q _ T _ C

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) R C J Q J R R → Q **R** T J **C** - Q R **J** J C - **Q** R T **J** C - Q **R** T **R** C

2) R C Q T J R J → Q **R** T J **C** - Q R **Q** J C - **T** R T **J** C - Q **R** T **J** C

3) R C T Q J R J → Q **R** T J **C** - Q R **T** J C - **Q** R T **J** C - Q **R** T **J** C

 
• Here **"QRTJC"** is repeated.

4) C R T Q J R J → Q **C** T J **R** - Q R **T** J C - **Q** R T **J** C - Q **R** T **J** C

 
• Option (3) gives the pattern of :- Q R T J C - Q R T J C - Q R T J C - Q R T J C

Hence, the correct answer is **"R C T Q J R J".**

questions.question: There are eight friends, namely A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H, sitting around a circular table facing the centre but not necessarily in the same order. F, is the immediate neighbour of D. C is second to the right of A. There are only two persons between A and D. E and G are immediate neighbours, while H and F are also immediate neighbours. B is third to the left of F. D is third to the left of G. How many persons are sitting between B and G, when counted in clockwise direction from B?

There are eight friends, namely A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H, sitting around a circular table facing the centre but not necessarily in the same order.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some wools are fabrics.

All fabrics are soft.

**Conclusions:**

I. All wools are soft.

II. Some wools are soft

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:

I. All wools are soft → False (As All fabrics are soft and Some wools are fabrics so, All wools are soft is false)

II. Some wools are soft → True (As All fabrics are soft and Some wools are fabrics so, Some wools are soft is true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II is true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

38 : 6 :: 83 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**(First number - 2)¹/² = Second number**

 
• 38 : 6 → (38 - 2)¹/² = 36¹/² = 6
 
• 83 : ? → (83 - 2)¹/² = 81¹/² = 9

Hence, the correct answer is **"9".**

questions.question:
If ‘H’ denotes ‘×’, ‘J’ denotes ‘-’, ‘D’ denotes ‘+’ and ‘Y’ denotes ‘÷’, then what will be the value of the following expression?

105 J 29 H 96 Y 16 D 84
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1a2f9ab33e780cba5010b6de702b28619de1d1b1c922808fce2123379d05d37.png] 

 
 

 **Alphabets**
 H
 J
 D
 Y
 
 

 **Operators**
 × 
 -
 +
 ÷ 
 
 

Given expression is : 105 J 29 H 96 Y 16 D 84 

After replacing operators in place of alphabets the expression is as follows : 105 - 29 × 96 ÷ 16 + 84

= 105 - 29 × __**96 ÷ 16**__ + 84

= 105 - __**29 × 6**__ + 84

= __**105**__ - 174 __**+ 84**__

= __**189 - 174**__

=** 15**

Hence, the correct answer is **"15".**
